checks.label: Accessibility
checks.what: No unlabelled controls, missing alt text, clickable non-interactive elements, removed focus outlines or hand-made dialogs in the source.

checks.label: Valid item
checks.what: A kebab-case name, a known type, and at least one file with a path and content.

checks.label: Dependencies declared
checks.what: Every package the code imports is in dependencies, and every shared registry component it imports is in registryDependencies.

checks.label: Theme tokens
checks.what: Colors come from theme tokens, not hard-coded hex or rgb values, so the item follows the theme and dark mode.

checks.label: States
checks.what: Data views handle loading, empty and error, not only the filled case.

checks.label: Motion
checks.what: No endless decorative animation, which cannot be paused for people who ask for less motion.

checks.label: Right to left
checks.what: Logical classes (ms-, pe-, text-start) instead of physical ones (ml-, pr-, text-left), so the layout mirrors.

checks.label: Described
checks.what: A title and a description that says what the item is (20 characters or more).

checks.label: Documented
checks.what: A docs note, or at least one example item in the registry.

checks.label: Attributed
checks.what: The item names its author or license, so you know who maintains it.
